question: Bend the map, and falling is straight

scene.title: Bend the map, and falling is straight
scene.subtitle: A map of height and time, bent so that the path of most time is a straight line.
scene.takeaway: Gravity bends the map of space and time. Falling things go straight on it. Standing still means being pushed.

beats.title: A flat map
beats.body: Here is a map of height and time. Without gravity it stays flat. The straight path, staying put, keeps the most time.

beats.title: Throw, then bend
beats.body: With gravity, the thrown ball’s path curves on the flat map. Now bend the map so that straight lines are the paths of most time. The ball’s path becomes straight, and the held clock’s path is the one that curves.

beats.title: Who is pushed?
beats.body: Nothing pushes the ball: it goes straight. The ground pushes the held clock off a straight path the whole time. Change the gravity to bend the map more or less.
